EmailTemplate.name: Pathway Selection - Form Invitation
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Succession Pathway Options - DAF Account {!Case.FinancialAccount__r.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Case.ContactName},
Thank you for speaking with us regarding the Donor-Advised Fund account held by {!Case.Account.Name}. As discussed during our conversation, we are pleased to provide you with the Succession Recommendation process to formalize your pathway selection.
YOUR OPTIONS (as discussed): We reviewed the three pathway options available to you:
1. FINAL GRANT TO CHARITY Direct the account balance as charitable grants to organizations of your choice
2. TRANSFER TO NEW DAF ACCOUNT Become the new account holder and continue charitable giving
3. DISCLAIM SUCCESSOR RIGHTS Decline your rights, and the account will be handled per organizational policy
NEXT STEPS: We will follow up with you via phone within the next 3-5 business days to complete the pathway selection process and collect any necessary documentation.
If you have specific charities in mind for grants, or questions about the new account setup process, please have that information ready when we speak.
REQUIRED DOCUMENTS (please gather): Regardless of which pathway you select, you will need: • Certified copy of death certificate • Government-issued photo ID (driver's license or passport)
Additional documents may be required depending on your pathway selection.
SUPPORT: If you have any questions before our follow-up call, please contact me directly: • Phone: {!Case.Owner.Phone} • Email: {!Case.Owner.Email} • Case Number: {!Case.CaseNumber}
We are here to support you through this process.
Warm regards,
{!Case.Owner.Name} Estate Administration Team DAFGiving360
